rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a place or thing is filled with light, colour, liquid, or another substance.

example.english: Morning sunlight began to suffuse the whole room.
example.traditional: 晨早嘅陽光充滿成間屋。
example.jyutping: san4 zou2 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 cung1 mun5 sing4 gaan1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when light, colour, darkness, or a similar effect spreads over and envelops an area.

example.english: Night began to suffuse the entire beach.
example.jyutping: je6 sik1 lung5 zaau3 zyu6 seng4 go3 hoi2 taan1

rows.note: Use this mainly when a diffuse smell, smoke, mist, colour, or light fills the surrounding space.

example.english: Thin mist began to suffuse the valley.
example.jyutping: bok6 mou6 nei4 maan6 saan1 guk1
